summary: FibroBiologics filed an 8-K reporting Nasdaq's confirmation that it has resolved previous listing deficiencies. The company regained compliance with the bid price rule (Rule 5550(a)(2)) on April 17, 2026, and the stockholders' equity rule (Rule 5550(b)(1)) on March 9, 2026, closing the listing matter. However, it remains subject to a one-year mandatory panel monitor for each rule. Any future non-compliance would result in immediate delisting without a cure period, though a hearing can be requested. The filing is a regulatory update on listing status, not a transactional special situation.
